## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

This 2-fascicle text by [竺佛念](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%AB%BA%E4%BD%9B%E5%BF%B5) Zhú Fóniàn treats the Buddhist doctrine of the *zhōng yīn* 中陰 (Skt. *antarābhava*) — the *intermediate state* between death and rebirth, a controversial topic in Indian Buddhist abhidharma. The Mahāyāna *Zhōng yīn jīng* presents the bodhisattva-perspective on this transitional state.

**Abstract**

The translation belongs to Zhú Fóniàn's Yáo-Qín period (365–411 CE).
